title: Vibe Graphing: 10x More Affordable than Vibe Coding (MAS-Factory)
summary: Discover AI editorial introducing 'vibe graphing' — beyond vibe-coding, an intent-driven computation graph as the orchestration substrate for multi-agent systems. MAS-Factory tooling generates automated topology design for multi-agent configurations: blueprint front-end + execution engine back-end + dynamic switches (e.g. Q&A agent activates retry-loop or publish path). Claims 10x cheaper than vibe-coding for multi-agent workflow scaling.
claims: Vibe-coding is approaching diminishing returns; multi-agent system orchestration is the next layer
Vibe-graphing: intent-driven computation graph as the multi-agent topology specification language
MAS-Factory: blueprint-front-end + execution-engine-back-end + dynamic-switch topology pattern
Q&A agent + retry-loop / publish-path switch pattern for quality-assured multi-agent workflows
Claimed 10x cost reduction vs vibe-coding for equivalent multi-agent functionality
